purpose: Clear billing case: user reports a duplicate charge and asks for a refund.
message: Hi, I just checked my credit card statement and I was charged twice for the same invoice last Tuesday. Can you refund the duplicate charge as soon as possible?

purpose: Clear technical case: app crash with concrete OS and version.
message: Your mobile app crashes every time I open the Settings screen on my Pixel 7 running Android 14. I have reinstalled twice and it still crashes. Please fix.

purpose: Clear sales case: prospective customer comparing plans and asking about a trial.
message: Hi! I'm comparing your Team and Business plans for a 25-person company. Does the Team plan include SSO, and can we try it before buying?

purpose: Ambiguous case: real support message that touches both login (technical) and billing-cycle timing.
message: I haven't been able to log in since this morning, and I also got a billing-cycle email yesterday that I want to confirm before I try again. Can someone help me figure out what's going on?

purpose: Off-topic case: not a support request; expects unknown.
message: Hi! What's the weather like in Hartford today? I'm visiting next week.
